name: requirement_analyzer
description: Use when: analyzing user requirements, creating AI implementation documents at docs/ai_plans/, and proposing the best execution agent.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file from the project workspace.

function.name: search_codebase
function.description: Search for patterns across the codebase.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file (used to save implementation plans).

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Pause the agent loop and ask the user a clarifying question.

platform_notes: Load canonical_spec file first. Do NOT implement features. Save plan at docs/ai_plans/implement_<feature-name>.md. Output a Handover Block instead of invoking agents directly.
